feature.cloud_shadows.opacity_tooltip: Higher values make cloud shadows darker.
feature.dynamic_cubemaps.creator_info: You must enable creator mode by adding the shader define CREATOR
feature.dynamic_cubemaps.enable_ssr_tool: Enable Screen Space Reflections on Water
feature.dynamic_cubemaps.vr_restart_requ: A restart is required to enable in VR. Save Settings after enabling and restart the game.
feature.exp_height_fog.apply_vanilla_fad: Applies vanilla fade brightness to exponential height fog.
feature.exp_height_fog.dir_inscattering_:
Controls the asymmetry of inscattering via the Henyey-Greenstein phase function.
Positive values produce forward scattering (glow around sun).
Zero is isotropic. Negative values produce back scattering.
feature.exp_height_fog.disable_vanilla_f: Disables the vanilla fog entirely. Only exponential height fog will be applied.
feature.extended_materials.enable_comple: Enables support for the Complex Material specification which makes use of the environment mask. This includes parallax, as well as more realistic metals and specular reflections. May lead to some warped textures on modded content which have an invalid alpha channel in their environment mask.
feature.extended_materials.enable_height: Enables landscape texture blending based on parallax.
feature.extended_materials.enable_legacy: Enables terrain parallax using the alpha channel of each landscape texture. Therefore, all landscape textures must support parallax for this effect to work properly.
feature.extended_materials.enable_parall: Enables parallax on standard meshes made for parallax.
Enables a fix reducing parallax scale on curved and smooth normal triangles.
feature.extended_materials.enable_shadow: Enables cheap soft shadows when using parallax. This applies to all directional and point lights.
feature.extended_materials.extend_shadow: Extends parallax shadows beyond the range of parallax. Small performance impact.
feature.extended_translucency.blend_weig: Control the blend weight of the effect applied to the final result.
feature.extended_translucency.default_ma:
Anisotropic transluency will adjust the opacity based on your view angle to the translucent surface.
  - Disabled: No anisotropic transluency, flat alpha.
  - Rim Edge: Naive rim light effect with no physics model, the edge of the geometry is always opaque even its full transparent.
  - Isotropic Fabric: Imaginary fabric weaved from threads in one direction, respect normal map, also works well for layer of glass panels.
  - Anisotropic Fabric: Common fabric weaved from tangent and birnormal direction, ignores normal map.
feature.extended_translucency.skinned_me: Control if this effect should only apply to skinned mesh, check this option if your are seeing undesired effect on random objects.
feature.extended_translucency.softness_t: Control the softness of the alpha increase, increase the softness reduce the increased amount of alpha.
feature.extended_translucency.transparen: Transluent material will make the material more opaque on average, which could be different from the intent, reduce the alpha to counter this effect and increase the dynamic range of the output.
feature.grass_lighting.brightness_toolti: Darkens the grass textures to look better with the new lighting
feature.grass_lighting.detection_thresho: Threshold for detecting complex grass textures. Lower values are more strict.
feature.grass_lighting.override_complex_: Override the settings set by the grass mesh author. Complex grass authors can define the brightness for their grass meshes. However, some authors may not account for the extra lights available from Community Shaders. This option will treat their grass settings like non-complex grass. This was the default in Community Shaders < 0.7.0
feature.grass_lighting.sss_tooltip: Subsurface Scattering (SSS) amount. Soft lighting controls how evenly lit an object is. Back lighting illuminates the back face of an object. Combined to model the transport of light through the surface.
feature.hair_specular.enable_self_shadow:
Enables screen-space self-shadowing for hair.
Marschner hair model might have overly bright transmission without self-shadowing.
feature.hair_specular.enable_tangent_shi:
Enables the use of a tangent shift texture to vary specular highlights across hair strands.
Result may vary based on the hair model used.
feature.hair_specular.glossiness_tooltip:
Controls the glossiness of the hair.
Glossiness in Kajiya-Kay mode maps to the specular exponent.
In Marschner mode, it controls the roughness of the hair surface.
feature.hair_specular.hair_mode_tooltip:
Select the hair shading model to use.
Kajiya-Kay is an empirical model that simulates hair specular highlights.
Marschner is a more physically-based model that simulates hair light interaction.
Both models are anisotropic and support tangent-based shading.
Without self-shadowing, Marschner may look overly bright because of transmission.
feature.ibl.dalc_amount_tooltip:
Blends the IBL brightness toward the game's vanilla ambient (DALC) level.
0 = no matching (pure IBL brightness), 1 = fully matched to vanilla ambient.
feature.ibl.dalc_mode_tooltip:
How the DALC-to-IBL brightness ratio is computed:
Luminance Ratio: Scalar ratio from overall luminance (loses DALC color tint).
Color Ratio: Per-channel ratio (preserves DALC color tint).
DALC + Sky: Uses vanilla ambient as base, sky IBL on top. Skylighting only affects sky.
DALC + Sky (Directional): Same, but Skylighting also dims vanilla ambient per-direction.
feature.ibl.enable_ibl_tooltip: Toggle IBL. When enabled, ambient lighting is derived from cubemap spherical harmonics instead of the vanilla system.
feature.ibl.env_ibl_saturation_tooltip:
Color saturation of the environment IBL.
Lower values produce more neutral ambient light; higher values produce more vivid color.
feature.ibl.env_ibl_scale_tooltip:
Intensity multiplier for the environment IBL (from Dynamic Cubemaps).
Controls how strongly the surrounding environment contributes to ambient lighting.
feature.ibl.fog_mix_tooltip:
Blends the fog color toward the IBL ambient color.
0 = vanilla fog, 1 = fog fully tinted by IBL.
feature.ibl.preserve_fog_luminance_toolt:
When Fog Mix is active, rescales the IBL-tinted fog to keep the original fog brightness.
Prevents fog from becoming too bright or too dark.
feature.ibl.sky_ibl_saturation_tooltip:
Color saturation of the sky IBL.
Lower values produce more neutral ambient light; higher values produce more vivid color.
feature.ibl.sky_ibl_scale_tooltip:
Intensity multiplier for the sky IBL (from the game's native reflections cubemap).
Controls how strongly the sky contributes to ambient lighting.
feature.ibl.use_static_ibl: Use Static IBL For Out-of-World Objects
feature.ibl.use_static_ibl_tooltip: Uses pre-baked static IBL cubemap textures for objects rendered outside the game world (e.g. inventory items, loading screens).
feature.interior_sun.force_double_sided_: Disables backface culling during sun shadowmap rendering in interiors. Will prevent most light leaking through unmasked/unprepared interiors at a small performance cost.
feature.interior_sun.interior_shadow_dis: Sets the distance shadows are rendered at in interiors. Lower values provide higher quality shadows and improved performance but may cause distant interior spaces to light up incorrectly.
feature.light_editor.enable_tooltip: Allows for modifying lights in real-time to preview changes. Light Placer lights can be saved back to their JSON configs. Not intended for gameplay use.
feature.light_editor.save_to_light_place: Save current settings to the Light Placer JSON.
feature.light_editor.shadows_only_toolti: Only show lights with HemiShadow or OmniShadow flags.
feature.light_editor.spotlight_not_appli: Spotlight: ISL light type flags not applicable
feature.light_limit_fix.debug_feature_en: DEBUG FEATURE - LIGHT LIMIT VISUALISATION ENABLED
feature.light_limit_fix.enable_lights_vi: Enables visualization of the light limit
feature.light_limit_fix.lights_vis_mode_:
- Visualise the light limit. Red when the "strict" light limit is reached (portal-strict lights).
 - Visualise the number of strict lights.
 - Visualise the number of clustered lights.
 - Visualize the Shadow Mask.
feature.perf_overlay.post_fg_graph_toolt:
FSR Frame Generation uses calculated timing data (2x Pre-FG).
DLSS Frame Generation provides measured timing data.
feature.perf_overlay.restore_defaults_to: Restores Performance Overlay settings to defaults, including graphs, appearance, and update intervals.
feature.perf_overlay.show_in_overlay_too:
Opens performance overlay in a separate window that stays open
even when the main menu is closed.
feature.renderdoc.capture_control_toolti: Manual capture creation and basic controls
feature.renderdoc.capture_dir_tooltip: Right-click to copy the directory path.
feature.renderdoc.capture_files_tooltip: View and manage individual capture files
feature.renderdoc.capture_frames_tooltip: Number of consecutive frames to capture. 1 uses a normal RenderDoc capture; higher values use TriggerMultiFrameCapture.
feature.renderdoc.capture_size_tooltip: Total size of all capture files in the captures directory
feature.renderdoc.comments_tooltip: Additional comments will be appended to automatic metadata and embedded in the .rdc file
feature.renderdoc.confirm_delete: Are you sure you want to delete all capture files?
feature.renderdoc.delete_size: This will permanently remove %u MB of capture data.
feature.renderdoc.double_click_hint: Double-click a filename to open the capture file
feature.renderdoc.enable_capture_tooltip: Enable RenderDoc frame capture for providing debug captures to the Community Shaders team.
Enabling capture will force-enable frame annotations for easier debugging and will restore the previous setting when disabled.
feature.renderdoc.hover_hint: Hover over filenames for file details
feature.renderdoc.not_enough_space: Not enough free disk space to create a capture.
feature.renderdoc.restart_to_disable: Requires restart to disable RenderDoc capture, performance will be severely impacted.
feature.renderdoc.restart_to_enable: Requires restart to enable RenderDoc capture.
feature.renderdoc.space_required: At least {} MB of free space is required.
feature.screen_space_shadows.bilinear_th: Depth threshold for edge detection during bilinear interpolation. Higher values smooth more aggressively across edges.
feature.screen_space_shadows.enable_tool: Enable screen-space contact shadows from the sun/moon direction.
feature.screen_space_shadows.sample_coun: Multiplier for shadow ray sample count. Higher values increase shadow reach at the cost of performance. Adapts to render resolution.
feature.screen_space_shadows.shadow_cont: Contrast boost for the shadow transition. Higher values produce harder shadow edges.
feature.screen_space_shadows.surface_thi: Assumed thickness of surfaces for shadow detection. Lower values produce thinner, more precise shadows.
feature.screen_space_shadows.vr_stereo_s: Synchronizes shadow data between left and right eyes via bilateral reprojection and applies a depth-weighted blur to reduce per-eye noise. Uses min-blend so if either eye detects an occluder, the shadow is preserved.
feature.screenshot.async_note: Capture and save run asynchronously - no frame stall.
feature.screenshot.folder_tooltip:
Relative paths resolve against the Skyrim install dir.
Absolute paths (e.g. D:\Captures) save there directly.
feature.screenshot.hotkey_collision:
This hotkey collides with vanilla PrintScreen; both saves will fire.
Set bAllowScreenShot=0 in Skyrim.ini to suppress vanilla, or pick a
different hotkey above.
feature.screenshot.sdr_note:
Saves SDR .bmp files. HDR scenes are tonemapped (Reinhard) so the saved
image matches what's on screen. For true HDR files with HDR10 metadata,
use Xbox Game Bar (Win+G) or your GPU vendor's overlay (saves .jxr).
feature.sky_sync.custom_angle_tooltip: Set a custom angle for the sun's trajectory.
feature.sky_sync.enabled_tooltip: Enable or disable Sky Sync features.
feature.sky_sync.min_shadow_elevation_to: The minimum angle sunlight will set to. Caps shadow length. Higher = shorter shadows at sunset/sunrise.
feature.sky_sync.moon_light_source_toolt: Select which moon casts shadows during the night.
feature.sky_sync.sun_path_tooltip: Choose the trajectory the sun takes across the sky.
feature.sky_sync.sun_position_offsets_de: Moves sun height during sunrise/sunset. Reset weather to see changes.
feature.sky_sync.sunrise_begin_tooltip: Offset for when the sun starts rising.
feature.sky_sync.sunrise_end_tooltip: Offset for when the sun finishes rising.
feature.sky_sync.sunset_begin_tooltip: Offset for when the sun starts setting.
feature.sky_sync.sunset_end_tooltip: Offset for when the sun finishes setting.
feature.sky_sync.use_alternate_sun_path_: Calculate sun position based on time of day and season instead of vanilla movement.
feature.skylighting.max_zenith_tooltip: Smaller angles creates more focused top-down shadow.
feature.skylighting.min_visibility_desc: Minimum visibility values. Diffuse darkens objects. Specular removes the sky from reflections.
feature.skylighting.rebuild_tooltip: Changes below require rebuilding, a loading screen, or moving away from the current location to apply.
feature.ssgi.ao_radius_tooltip: A smaller radius produces tighter AO.
feature.ssgi.depth_fade_range_tooltip: Distance range where depth-based effects fade out.
feature.ssgi.enabled_tooltip: Enable Screen Space Global Illumination. When disabled, all other settings are ignored.
feature.ssgi.geometry_weight_tooltip: Higher value makes the blur more sensitive to differences in geometry.
feature.ssgi.hq_specular_il_tooltip: An experimental specular GI that is more accurate but requires more samples. Won't be blurred.
feature.ssgi.il_radius_tooltip: A larger radius produces wider IL.
feature.ssgi.max_frame_accumulation_tool: How many past frames to accumulate results with. Higher values are less noisy but potentially cause ghosting.
feature.ssgi.min_screen_radius_tooltip: The minimum screen-space effect radius as proportion of display width, to prevent far field AO being too small.
feature.ssgi.movement_disocclusion_toolt:
If a pixel has moved too far from the last frame, its radiance will not be carried to this frame.
Lower values are stricter.
feature.ssgi.slices_tooltip:
How many directions do the samples take.
Controls noise.
feature.ssgi.steps_per_slice_tooltip:
How many samples does it take in one direction.
Controls accuracy of lighting, and noise when effect radius is large.
feature.ssgi.thickness_tooltip: How thick the occluders are. Only affects AO.
feature.ssgi.vanilla_ssao_tooltip: Enable Skyrim's built-in SSAO. Usually disabled when using SSGI to avoid double-darkening.
feature.ssgi.vanilla_ssao_tooltip_vr: Vanilla SSAO is not supported in VR.
feature.sss.mean_free_path_color_tooltip: Controls how far light goes into the subsurface in the red, green, and blue channel. It is scaled by the Mean Free Path Distance.
feature.sss.mean_free_path_distance_tool: Controls the distance that Mean Free Path Color goes into subsurface.
feature.terrain_blending.enable_tooltip: Enable seamless blending between terrain and objects.
feature.unified_water.use_optimised_mesh:
Uses meshes with significantly lower tri-count for improved performance with no visual quality loss.
Will only affect newly created water - requires a change of location or game restart to take effect.
feature.upscaling.dlss_model_preset_tool:
Choose which DLSS AI model preset to use.
Each model offers different visual quality, performance, and motion stability.
Set to 'Default' for automatic selection based on your Upscale Preset and hardware.
Changing this setting requires a restart to take effect.
feature.upscaling.fps_limit_tooltip_2: Start about 2-3 FPS below refresh rate (e.g. 117 for 120 Hz).
feature.upscaling.frame_generation_avail: AMD FSR Frame Generation is available.
feature.upscaling.frame_generation_desc: Frame Generation interpolates real frames with generated ones for a smoother experience
feature.upscaling.frame_generation_in_me: Keeps frame generation active while game menus are open.
May feel smoother, but increases menu input latency.
feature.upscaling.frame_generation_proxy: Requires a D3D11 to D3D12 proxy which can create compatibility issues
feature.upscaling.frame_generation_resta: Toggling this setting requires a restart to work correctly
feature.upscaling.frame_generation_tech: Uses AMD FSR Frame Generation technology
feature.upscaling.low_latency_boost_tool: Keeps GPU clocks higher to avoid latency spikes at low GPU load.
Useful if frametime jumps; costs extra power and heat.
feature.upscaling.low_latency_mode_toolt: Cuts input delay by syncing CPU work closer to the GPU.
Can reduce max FPS a little, but usually feels more responsive.
feature.upscaling.reflex_blocked_by_fg: Reflex is unavailable while the DX12 frame-generation swapchain is active.
feature.upscaling.reflex_not_available: Reflex is not available. Ensure sl.reflex.dll is present and restart.
feature.upscaling.streamline_logging_res: Changing this requires a restart to take effect.
feature.upscaling.streamline_logging_too: Streamline logging controls the verbosity of NVIDIA Streamline backend logs. Useful for debugging issues with DLSS/DLSS-G.
feature.upscaling.use_fps_limit_tooltip_: Uses Reflex's internal FPS cap for steadier frametimes.
Can lower latency versus uncapped rendering.
feature.upscaling.use_markers_to_optimiz: Uses frame markers for tighter Reflex timing.
Try On first; turn Off if it causes stutter on your setup.
feature.upscaling.vr_intermediates_not_c: VR intermediates not yet created (enter game world)
feature.vr_stereo.enable_stereo_reprojec:
Reprojects Eye 0 (left) pixels into Eye 1 (right) using depth and motion data,
skipping redundant full shading where the views overlap.
Reduces GPU cost in VR by shading each pixel fewer times per frame.
feature.vr_stereo.forward_occlusion_scal:
Prevents Eye 0 silhouette edges from bleeding onto Eye 1 backgrounds.
Fires when Eye 0 depth is within this fraction of Eye 1 depth (e.g. 0.5 = Eye 0 less than 2x Eye 1 depth).
Lower = more aggressive. 0 = disabled.
feature.vr_stereo.full_blend_distance_to: Geometry closer than this distance (game units) is fully shaded in both eyes and bilaterally blended for 2x supersampling. 0 = disabled.
feature.vr_stereo.full_blend_zone_hint: Cyan = full blend zone (closer = stronger tint)
feature.vr_stereo.pom_depth_scale_toolti:
Scale factor for POM depth correction in stereo reprojection.
1.0 = physical scale. Increase for more visible POM stereo depth.
feature.vr_stereo.restart_required: Restart is required to enable VR stereo reprojection.

menu.advanced.active_shaders_tooltip: List of shaders that have been used in recent frames. Enable Shader Blocking above to use hotkeys to cycle through and block shaders for debugging. Shaders not used for ~1 second are removed from this list.
menu.advanced.avg_parallelism_tooltip_1: Average useful concurrency in this workload.
menu.advanced.avg_parallelism_tooltip_2: Roughly the worker count where adding more cores gives diminishing returns.
menu.advanced.avoid_flow_control_tooltip:
Adds D3DCOMPILE_AVOID_FLOW_CONTROL to the shader compiler flags.
Forces fxc to flatten branches into predicated ops rather than emitting dynamic flow control. Often a win for short branch bodies and uniformly-taken branches; usually a loss for long divergent branches that vanilla flow control would skip entirely.
Resets every launch. Toggling this clears the shader cache and triggers a full recompile.
menu.advanced.background_compiler_thread: Number of threads used to compile shaders during gameplay. Defaults to half of performance cores to avoid impacting the render thread. Higher values finish compilation faster but may cause stuttering.
menu.advanced.clear_shader_cache_tooltip: Clear all compiled shaders from memory. Forces recompilation of all shaders on next use.
menu.advanced.column_frame_pct_tooltip: Percentage of draw calls this frame
menu.advanced.compiler_threads_tooltip: Number of threads used to compile shaders at startup. Defaults to all logical cores minus one for OS headroom (E-cores included). Higher values finish compilation faster but may make the system less responsive.
menu.advanced.compute_tooltip: Replace Compute Shaders. When false, will disable the custom Compute Shaders for the types above. For developers to test whether CS shaders match vanilla behavior.
menu.advanced.copy_info_tooltip: Copy complete shader information including cache path to clipboard
menu.advanced.dump_shaders_tooltip: Dump shaders at startup. This should be used only when reversing shaders. Normal users don't need this.
menu.advanced.enable_file_watcher_toolti: Automatically recompile shaders on file change. Intended for developing.
menu.advanced.enable_shader_blocking_too: Enables hotkeys to cycle through and block individual shaders for debugging purposes.
menu.advanced.frame_annotations_tooltip: Enable detailed frame annotations for debugging render passes and draw calls.
menu.advanced.half_precision_tooltip:
Adds D3DCOMPILE_PARTIAL_PRECISION to the shader compiler flags.
Lets fxc downgrade unmarked float ops to FP16 where it can prove safety, on top of the existing min16float type hints.
On FP16-capable GPUs (Pascal+ / GCN+ / Skylake+) this can halve register pressure and double ALU throughput, but it can also introduce minor visual differences in shaders that haven't been audited for precision sensitivity.
Toggling this clears the shader cache and triggers a full recompile.
menu.advanced.infinite_core_efficiency_t: How close runtime is to the infinite-core lower bound.
menu.advanced.infinite_core_gap_tooltip_: Defined as 100 * (1 - S / T_p). Lower is better.
menu.advanced.log_level_tooltip: Log level. Trace is most verbose. Default is info.
menu.advanced.makespan_tooltip: Observed wall-clock duration for the full shader build.
menu.advanced.parallelism_tooltip_1: Computed lazily from the last completed build.
menu.advanced.parallelism_tooltip_2: Only evaluated when this Statistics section is open.
menu.advanced.pixel_tooltip: Replace Pixel Shaders. When false, will disable the custom Pixel Shaders for the types above. For developers to test whether CS shaders match vanilla behavior.
menu.advanced.press_key_shader_block_nex: Press any key for Shader Block Next...
menu.advanced.press_key_shader_block_pre: Press any key for Shader Block Previous...
menu.advanced.queue_wait_tooltip_1: Time spent waiting in the ready queue before a worker started compilation.
menu.advanced.queue_wait_tooltip_2: Useful for identifying scheduler-induced delay separate from compile cost.
menu.advanced.shader_defines_tooltip: Defines for Shader Compiler. Semicolon ";" separated. Clear with space. Rebuild shaders after making change. Compute Shaders require a restart to recompile.
menu.advanced.span_tooltip_1: Critical-path lower bound, approximated by the single slowest shader.
menu.advanced.span_tooltip_2: Even infinite cores cannot finish faster than this.
menu.advanced.vertex_tooltip: Replace Vertex Shaders. When false, will disable the custom Vertex Shaders for the types above. For developers to test whether CS shaders match vanilla behavior.
menu.advanced.work_metric: Work (W, sum of task wall times): %s
menu.advanced.work_tooltip_1: Total compile work: sum of all per-shader wall-clock compile times.
menu.advanced.work_tooltip_2: This is not CPU time; it is accumulated task elapsed time.
menu.advanced.work_tooltip_3: Equivalent serial time on one worker if overhead stayed the same.
menu.clear_shader_cache_tooltip:
Clear Shader Cache

Clears the shader cache and disk cache (if enabled).
The Shader Cache is the collection of compiled shaders which replace
the vanilla shaders at runtime. The Disk Cache is a collection of
compiled shaders on disk. Clearing will mean that shaders are
recompiled only when the game re-encounters them.
menu.disable_at_boot_desc: Select features to disable at boot. This is the same as deleting a feature.ini file. Restart will be required to reenable.
menu.faq.a1: Community Shaders is a comprehensive graphics enhancement framework for Skyrim that provides advanced lighting, materials, and visual effects. It's designed to be modular, allowing you to enable only the features you want while maintaining good performance.
menu.faq.a2: Each feature can be found in the left sidebar menu. Click on any feature to access its settings. Most features include presets and detailed tooltips to help you understand what each setting does.
menu.faq.a3: Features may fail to load due to hardware incompatibility, missing dependencies, or conflicts with other mods. Check the 'Feature Issues' tab for detailed information about any problematic features.
menu.faq.a4: Failed shaders are usually caused by mixed file versions. Ensure all features are up to date and avoid mixing files from test builds or outdated versions. Please review the 'Feature Issues' tab and/or Wiki for more information. Update your features and remove any obsolete features.
menu.faq.a5: Start by enabling the Performance Overlay to monitor your FPS. Consider disabling expensive features like Screen Space GI or reducing quality settings. The 'Display' tab also includes upscaling options that can improve performance.
menu.faq.a6: No, Community Shaders is not compatible with ENB. Community Shaders will automatically disable itself if ENB is detected.
menu.faq.a7: By default, Community Shaders uses the END key to open this menu. If your keyboard doesn't have an END key or it's not working, you can change it in the General > Keybindings tab. You can also edit the hotkey in the JSON configuration files.
menu.faq.a8: We're always looking for talented developers to join the team! Check out our GitHub wiki for contribution guidelines and join our Discord server to connect with the development team. Whether you're interested in shader programming, C++ development, or documentation, there's always something to contribute.
menu.faq.a9: Yes! Community Shaders is completely open source and available on GitHub. You can view the source code, report issues, suggest features, and contribute to the project. The project is licensed under GPL, ensuring it remains free and open for everyone. Branding materials and assets (icons, nexus branding, typography, etc) are not covered by the GPL Licence. Any included assets may not be used without explicit permission.

menu.settings.skip_unchanged_shaders_too: When enabled, each shader is recompiled from source only if its .hlsl file is newer than the cached .bin on disk. Useful for iterative testing: change a shader file and only that shader is rebuilt. Requires 'Enable Disk Cache' to be active.
